_about: Purpose notes for the system map (generator: Praxis scripts/system-map, run with npm run system-map in Praxis). One line per component of this repo, keyed by the map's node id. Change a line in the same commit as the code it describes. The generator reports components with no line and lines whose component is gone.
nexus: The cockpit: the task board, the project and document review surfaces, and the window into what Praxis is doing.
nexus/+scripts: QA probes and verifiers, one-off migrations, logo exports and travel-update staging scripts for the Nexus repo.
nexus/api: Express and Socket.IO server on :4000 over the SQLite board. Every client goes through it.
nexus/dashboard: Next.js dashboard on :3000. Proxies /api/* to the Nexus API.
nexus/db/board-summary: Parses and serves the paginated, compact board listing (tasks per project, filtered by status) so clients avoid loading full task history.
nexus/db/client-access: Stores project-scoped entitlements for external client members, plus the immutable artifact-version and client-review ledger of who accepted which published version.
nexus/db/document-draft-versions: Derives editorial draft numbers from document content and groups immutable revision captures into labelled drafts for the review UI.
nexus/db/document-outgoing: SQLite store for approved outgoing-document envelopes (exact content and envelope hashes, grant, status); it records state but cannot deliver anything.
nexus/db/document-review-blockers: Helpers that validate a document's blocking task IDs and build the SQL that finds active tasks still holding up its review.
nexus/db/index: The board database facade: opens the SQLite file via better-sqlite3 and exposes the async methods for projects, tasks, documents, chat and members that routes call.
nexus/db/knowledge-lifecycle: Pure rules that validate project knowledge needs, evidence and applications and reopen stale knowledge; the caller owns the transaction.
nexus/db/member-memory: Append-only ledger of member facts, commitments and observations, with idempotent writes and supersession chains instead of edits.
nexus/db/project-checkpoints: Normalizes a project's ordered checkpoint plan and applies the single transition that advances or reopens a checkpoint on fresh evidence.
nexus/db/project-data: Shared validation for project writes: evidence, end-state criteria, needs and revision checks that every database writer applies to a project patch.
nexus/db/project-intake: Record-only project intake store: creates intakes and applies operations, with mutations and replay receipts committed in one SQLite transaction.
nexus/db/project-scope-decisions: Records operator scope decisions (end state, checkpoints, status changes) as immutable receipts written in the same board transaction as their effect.
nexus/db/raw: Opens and caches raw better-sqlite3 connections (writer or read-only) to the board database for code that needs SQL the db/index.js facade does not expose.
nexus/desktop: Tauri desktop shell around the dashboard; it starts the local operator session automatically (no sign-in form) and controls display presentation.
nexus/mcp: praxis-mind, the single agent-facing MCP server (stdio, one process per client): identity, vault, memory, brain and board tools for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.
nexus/mcp/identity: identity_whoami tool: tells an MCP caller who praxis-mind thinks it is, its privileges, and recent usage and cost.
nexus/mcp/lib: MCP server internals: auth, backends, board operations, ledger, rate limit, provenance, vault write.
nexus/routes/activity-events: Receives Praxis operational events and lists them for the dashboard Recent Activity feed (/api/ag/events).
nexus/routes/agents: Returns the local model catalog for the dashboard's agent screens.
nexus/routes/ai-chat: Main chat endpoint (/api/ai/chat): a thin relay that passes operator messages to Praxis, plus turn status, activity and operator identity reads.
nexus/routes/automatic-start: Operator-authenticated relay for listing, creating and cancelling automatic task-start requests; Praxis owns the durable request and its execution.
nexus/routes/broadcast: Receives Cortex artifact broadcasts at /api/broadcast and re-emits them over Socket.IO to connected dashboard clients.
nexus/routes/chat-files: Uploads and serves chat attachments by file id.
nexus/routes/chat-history: Manages chat conversations (list, create, switch, rename, delete) and serves stored message history so clients stay in sync across devices.
nexus/routes/client-access: Routes for project-scoped client access: a runtime-key surface for the trusted portal and an operator surface for granting and revoking entitlements and reviewing client decisions.
nexus/routes/contacts: The shared people directory at /api/members (/api/contacts is a legacy alias): members and council seats, project links, memory, evidence and profile proposals.
nexus/routes/dashboard: Dashboard statistics (/api/dashboard/stats) and the dependency-resolved board state (/api/board-state) that the dashboard reads.
nexus/routes/dispatches: Task dispatch history: one row per CLI dispatch attempt with prompt, executor, model, output, outcome and resumable session id, written by Praxis and read on the task screen.
nexus/routes/document-outgoing: Review surface for a document's exact outgoing envelope: view, edit, approve or decline, with claim and receipt calls for delivery, which Praxis performs.
nexus/routes/documents: Markdown document review API: registers files, tracks revisions, comments and review status, and serves documents and deliverables to the review UI.
nexus/routes/groundrules-labeling: Guided blind-labelling API for the Groundrules gold-set packet: sessions, staged items, answers and commits.
nexus/routes/health: Health check and API info endpoints (GET /api and GET /api/health).
nexus/routes/ingest: Ingests a URL or pasted text (including YouTube transcripts) as a note and forwards it to Cortex.
nexus/routes/ingestion-control: Proxies the dashboard's Knowledge Ingestion page to Praxis's ingestion control API: sources, run history, per-term views and recommendations.
nexus/routes/initiatives: CRUD and run endpoints for dashboard-level initiatives that span several projects.
nexus/routes/knowledge-activity: Read-only cockpit telemetry on knowledge-vault activity and authored documents, with no producer calls or writes.
nexus/routes/mail-draft-review: Lists mail drafts and relays operator send or decline decisions to Praxis, requiring direct operator identity and a body-bound proof.
nexus/routes/mcp-inline: Registry of external MCP servers (list, add, connect, disconnect) kept in memory, for the dashboard's MCP management screen.
nexus/routes/mcp-scopes: Manages per-server scopes and permissions for MCP tool servers, including preset scope templates and dangerous-scope flags.
nexus/routes/models: Lists, creates and deletes entries in the model catalog served to dashboard model pickers (/api/models).
nexus/routes/notes: Global and project-scoped notes (create, edit, delete) with tracking of which notes have been ingested.
nexus/routes/operator-session: Bootstraps the local operator session automatically for the dashboard and desktop app; the separate sign-in form is retired.
nexus/routes/praxis-stream: Relays Praxis's event stream to dashboard and mobile clients over one upstream connection, and proxies snapshot and pending-approval (HITL) endpoints.
nexus/routes/presence: Tracks which device the operator last used (heartbeats on real input) so voice announcements play only there.
nexus/routes/project-hub: Server-rendered LAB pages: a project roster and a per-project space with end state, needs, tasks and README, for projects without their own web UI.
nexus/routes/project-maintenance: Relays project autonomy grants and revocations to Praxis, accepted only from Robert's authenticated session.
nexus/routes/project-pulse: Batched per-project activity rollups (git state, task counts, recent operations) behind the bridge's project cards and project brief.
nexus/routes/project-workflows: CRUD, run, progress and advance endpoints for project-level workflows.
nexus/routes/projects: Project CRUD and scaffolding, plus needs, checkpoints, scope decisions, intake and end-state evidence endpoints for the board.
nexus/routes/push: Registers and removes mobile push tokens, lists them and sends push or test notifications.
nexus/routes/settings: Reads and writes environment settings and lists or rotates per-project API keys for the dashboard settings page.
nexus/routes/stakeholders: Lists a project's stakeholders and stakeholder-gated requests, and records approve, reject, duplicate or defer decisions on gated tasks for every caller.
nexus/routes/system: Reports host CPU, memory and ports, database status, and token budget, and toggles the code Critic, for the dashboard.
nexus/routes/system-map: Read-only, operator-authenticated route that serves the generated system map from the shared-mind vault to the dashboard's System Map page.
nexus/routes/tabs: Serves and updates the tab roster the Windows travel shell loads at launch, stored in a JSON file so tabs change without a rebuild.
nexus/routes/token-usage: Forwards /api/token-usage to the dashboard's daily token-throughput aggregation so remote viewers such as the travel shell can reach it.
nexus/routes/tools: Local tool endpoints for reading, writing and listing files, running shell commands, searching and creating tasks, guarded by write leases.
nexus/routes/updates: Serves the travel shell's self-update manifest and signed Windows installer through the tunnel from a fixed set of staged files.
nexus/routes/usage: Returns, records and resets token usage statistics tracked by the dashboard's own token tracker.
nexus/routes/usage-monitor: Proxies Praxis's usage monitor and model routing recommendation to the dashboard and travel shell.
nexus/server-root: server.js is the API entry: loads fleet env, mounts every route module, starts Socket.IO; sibling files hold chat context, push notifications and the presentation receiver.
nexus/services/approved-plan-followups: Works out which board tasks belong on today's follow-up list once the day's plan is approved; read-only and never grants execution.
nexus/services/astro-nightly: Overnight job for the Studio catalog that pulls NASA Exoplanet Archive and ArXiv astro-ph data, extracts it with the local model and fills derived physical parameters.
nexus/services/astro-parameters: Pure physics calculator that derives surface gravity, escape velocity, density, temperature, atmosphere and sky appearance from known specs for Studio catalog objects.
nexus/services/chat-activity: Tracks each chat turn's phase (received, working, replying, completed, failed) in memory and broadcasts it over Socket.IO; never runs or retries chat.
nexus/services/context-sync: Syncs a project's .context markdown files into the database, pulling from git first so git stays the source of truth.
nexus/services/context-window: Asks Praxis for the context window of the model a call will reach, and fits oversized text to it by saving the whole text to disk and sending the part that fits.
nexus/services/critic: Reviews proposed code with the Antigravity CLI before file writes to catch bugs, security issues and style problems; can be switched on or off.
nexus/services/dashboard-initiative-supe: Runs cross-project initiatives (security sweeps, dependency audits, documentation) by iterating target projects and executing the matching action.
nexus/services/document-decision-provena: Validates and binds executor-recorded document approvals to the operator's own review instruction, using the document executor credential.
nexus/services/document-praxis-proposals: Generates durable proposed replacement wording for a review comment through Praxis, bound to the source text; never records acceptance or writes the document.
nexus/services/document-registry: Decides which local files may be registered for document review, resolving symlinks inside registered project roots, and captures their content.
nexus/services/document-review-format: Pure helpers shared by the document review API and delivery outbox: anchor checks, submission snapshots and the chat turn text sent to Praxis.
nexus/services/document-unified-comments: Turns executor review findings into entries in the existing immutable review comment and thread store, with deterministic ids and passage anchors.
nexus/services/followup-activity: Tells Praxis when a task's board evidence materially changes so its idle follow-up timer wakes; never dispatches work.
nexus/services/hitl-answer-attachments: Validates photo attachments on inbox (HITL) answers against the chat upload store and rebuilds each reference server-side before it reaches Praxis.
nexus/services/horizons: Fetches real Solar System body positions and velocities from NASA JPL Horizons in SI units as starting conditions for the N-body simulation.
nexus/services/local-evidence-work: Reads the source batch waiting upstream of LM Studio so the cockpit can show local extraction progress; never starts or retries extraction.
nexus/services/local-model-work: Shows what the local model server is working on: its queue plus the durable Praxis jobs waiting to submit work; read-only.
nexus/services/local-operator-peer: Verifies, on macOS, which application owns the local TCP connection (pinned Nexus desktop app or Chrome default profile) as the basis for automatic operator sessions.
nexus/services/local-operator-session: Issues short-lived in-memory local operator sessions, with a signed cookie, to a pinned macOS app that passes the peer and code-signing check.
nexus/services/model-discovery: Supplies model sources and reasoning-effort tiers from Praxis's CLI model registry and OpenRouter free list, and syncs free models into the models table.
nexus/services/operator-access: Authenticates the operator behind a chat turn from a Cloudflare Access user or device session or a verified local app session, not the legacy local_user stub.
nexus/services/operator-task-origin: Records who filed a task (operator board create or chat dispatch) only after verifying the operator's session, so request bodies cannot claim operator origin.
nexus/services/praxis-client: The one place Nexus resolves Praxis's address and calls it over HTTP, with a single timeout and error shape.
nexus/services/praxis-env: Reads credentials Praxis already holds (usually its .env) so Nexus does not need a second copy; process env wins and a missing key reads as missing.
nexus/services/presentation-data: Builds read-only, allowlisted presentation views of board data and immutable document captures for display receivers.
nexus/services/presentations: Holds presentation sessions in memory: display inventories, pairing, and controller and receiver leases, revoked on restart, expiry, stop or missed heartbeat.
nexus/services/project-workflow-supervis: Runs project-level workflows (such as brand development, documentation, release) by generating tasks per stage and advancing stages with a human checkpoint.
nexus/services/review-media: Defines which file types document review accepts, how they are classified and hashed, the design package manifest, and the content-addressed blob store for reviewed bytes.
nexus/services/run-trace: Defines the fixed field list a production agent run's trace is judged against, so the attribution surface can say whether a run is auditable.
nexus/services/slate-lifecycle: Works out which of the four stages today's slate is in, and for how long, from the schedule file Praxis writes.
nexus/services/slate-qa-evidence: Reads Praxis's verification ledger, read-only, to show whether each slate slot actually passed QA, separate from dispatch evidence in the schedule.
nexus/services/solar-system-seed: Deterministic reference data for the Sun and planets (NASA fact sheet values) seeded into the Studio object catalog, since the nightly NASA pull omits them.
nexus/services/source-fetch: Fetches and cleans a URL source (YouTube title and transcript, JSON, text or HTML) for the route and Studio ingestion worker; the body returns whole.
nexus/services/studio-ingestion: Studio worker that discovers, dedups and fetches sources, extracts with the local model only, upserts into the object catalog, derives parameters and expands topics.
nexus/services/supervisor-sync: Watches the supervisor/ markdown artifacts and syncs them into the project_contexts table so the dashboard mirrors the filesystem.
nexus/services/system-monitor: Reports host CPU, memory and listening ports, plus Praxis statistics, for the dashboard, using a short cache.
nexus/services/task-dispatch-proof: Express middleware that gives an operator-flagged task dispatch a signed proof only after a verified human session, rejecting cross-site and unverified callers.
nexus/services/task-evidence: Builds the per-task completion evidence dossier (walkthrough, verify gate, code review gate, QA verdict) from existing records, with an explicit marker for missing pieces.
nexus/services/task-improvements: Read-only projection of optional QA improvement records for a task, scrubbed of runtime internals, for display in the cockpit.
nexus/services/task-progress: Builds read-only public progress commentary for a task from run logs, redacting secrets and never returning raw transcripts.
nexus/services/topic-access: Queries Cortex for knowledge topics (communities) whose entities were recently retrieved, without recording access itself.
nexus/services/usage-source: Labels each token or cost figure as measured, estimated, unavailable or unknown, so the dashboard never shows a bare unexplained number.
nexus/services/youtube-api: Thin YouTube Data API v3 client for Studio ingestion: fetches video metadata for search and channel sources and finds related videos.
nexus/store:nexus.db: The board database: projects, tasks, dispatches, documents and reviews, chat, members. Praxis also opens the file directly for backups and the execution scorecard.
nexus/vault-watcher: Launchd daemon that regenerates the vault's derived files (MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, SKILLS.md, LINKS.md, the search index) on every change, and commits and pushes the vault.
nexus/vault-watcher/core: Watcher implementation: projections, link graph, search index, skills mirror, write protocol, git sync.
